message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local authorities. In Atlanta, noise complaints are typically handled by the **City of Atlanta Department of Public Safety** (or the local police department if the issue involves immediate safety concerns). Here’s how you can submit a complaint: | Step | Action | Contact | |------|--------|---------| | 1 | Gather details | • Date & time of the disturbance
• Exact location (address or intersection)
• Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs)
• Any evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings) | | 2 | File online | Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website: and navigate to “Public Safety” → “Noise Complaints.” You’ll find an online form that accepts all the information above. | | 3 | Call for urgent cases | If the noise is ongoing or poses an immediate threat, call the Atlanta Police Department at **311** (for non-emergency calls) or **911** for emergencies. | | 4 | Follow up | After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Keep it handy for follow‑up inquiries. | **Quick links** * Online noise complaint form: https://www.atlantaga.gov/department-of-public-safety/noise-complaint-form * Atlanta Police Department non‑emergency line: 311 (within Georgia) or 911 (outside Georgia) * City of Atlanta main website: https://www.atlantaga.gov/ If you’re unsure which department handles your specific situation—such as a commercial noise issue or a residential nuisance—contact the City of Atlanta’s general information line at **(404) 576-4000**; they can direct you to the appropriate office.
